purpose: Prioritize uncertainty reduction without closing TOKEN_VAZIO by narrative or bypassing scientific prerequisites.
execution_rule: highest score among entries whose prerequisites are satisfied; P0 blockers outrank downstream work even when downstream information-gain score is higher

entries.name: materialize_and_verify_pantheon_stat_sys_covariance
entries.method: materialize exact official bytes, pin sidecar SHA-256, verify 1701x1701 value count, then run scripts/verify_pantheon_inputs.py --require-full-covariance
entries.falsifier: hash, size, dimension or value-count mismatch blocks the route
entries.providencia: Do not substitute diagonal errors or STATONLY covariance for STAT+SYS; preserve any mismatch as a blocked receipt.
entries.next_observable_step: obtain the official covariance bytes and produce a local/CI readiness receipt with exact hash

entries.name: bind_desi_13x13_covariance_to_primary_point_order
entries.source: committed DESI DR2 BAO covariance and primary-point registry
entries.provider: RLL materialization from DESI primary products
entries.method: validate 13x13 numeric shape, symmetry, positive diagonal, deterministic row/observable mapping and hash both matrix and ordered vector
entries.falsifier: shape, symmetry, diagonal, point-count or order mismatch blocks G2
entries.providencia: Make ordering a receipt field; matrix presence alone is insufficient.
entries.next_observable_step: emit ordered-vector SHA-256 beside covariance SHA-256 and compare against the joint likelihood consumer

entries.name: canonical_joint_likelihood_full_covariance
entries.source: existing joint_real_likelihood and FASE20 inference routes
entries.method: freeze one data/covariance/nuisance/prior manifest and require all competing models to consume the same compatible blocks
entries.falsifier: different covariance, sample, nuisance treatment or hidden smoke settings between models blocks model ranking
entries.providencia: Reconcile rather than duplicate the existing likelihood routes.
entries.next_observable_step: after G2 readiness, generate one manifest identifying exact data hashes, covariance hashes, parameter counts and likelihood code hash

entries.name: synthetic_recovery_and_null_injection
entries.source: generated controlled fixtures using frozen model implementations
entries.method: inject known LCDM and RLL parameter sets separately, recover them blind to generator labels, record coverage, false-positive and false-negative rates
entries.falsifier: pipeline cannot recover injected truth within preregistered coverage or invents RLL signal under LCDM null
entries.providencia: Use multiple seeds and keep failed recovery cases append-only.
entries.next_observable_step: define preregistered recovery tolerances after G5/G6 freeze

entries.name: reconcile_mcmc_dynesty_and_bic_proxy
entries.source: existing FASE20 MCMC/dynesty, joint likelihood and BIC-proxy artifacts
entries.method: rerun all inferential summaries from one frozen likelihood, prior registry, nuisance policy and environment; record convergence and logZ uncertainty
entries.falsifier: material disagreement persists after inputs and priors are identical, or convergence/seed stability fails
entries.providencia: Preserve ln(B10)<0 outcomes and posterior collapse; do not optimize them away.
entries.next_observable_step: produce a reconciliation table keyed by the same input manifest SHA-256

entries.name: materially_independent_replication
entries.method: clean replay, alternate sampler or likelihood implementation, then materially independent code path with declared tolerance
entries.falsifier: independent result changes model ranking beyond preregistered tolerance or cannot reconstruct inputs
entries.providencia: A same-code rerun is reproducibility, not independent replication.
entries.next_observable_step: freeze replication bundle after G6 without hidden local state

entries.name: perturbation_and_physical_closure
entries.source: RLL background equations plus future effective-fluid/field/EFT derivation
entries.method: declare rho, pressure, conservation, sound speed, anisotropic stress and stability; recover LCDM in CLASS/CAMB before enabling RLL sector
entries.falsifier: no conserved stable perturbative completion or failure to recover the standard baseline
entries.providencia: Do not use background-fit success as evidence for perturbative observables.
entries.next_observable_step: choose and document one physical interpretation of the added sector before backend patching

entries.name: reconcile_documented_orchestrator_path
entries.method: replace or qualify the stale orquestrador/rafaelia_orquestrador.py reference only after identifying intended ancestry; bind docs to tools/workflow_orchestrator.py when verified
entries.falsifier: historical path is later located and has a different authority role
entries.providencia: Do not silently rewrite ancestry; preserve the old reference in audit history.
entries.next_observable_step: search tag/branch ancestry for the historical path and issue a documentation-only delta receipt
